contextReview.basis: Direct review: cloudy night stone lanes, bakery/café fronts and pale stucco doorways under warm street lamps; no rain depicted (reflective paving is not rain); humidity not inferred.

approval.evidence: User explicitly approved these five editorials (01 v2, 02, 03, 04 v2, 05 v2) and the full automation (2026-11-02, Claude Code publication). Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: Hidden full shapes, backs, soles and the opposite shoe/earring are inferred. Brand, fibre composition and retail identity are unknown.

producerVisualReview.findings: All 25 products viewed on all four backgrounds. Full silhouettes, no baked opaque rectangles, no visible edge halos or clipping. Clothing/shoe colors and construction agree with approved editorials; hidden areas conservatively reconstructed as documented. Shoe pairs top-down and aligned. No scene props included.

deck.ko: 짧은 회색 재킷과 길게 이어지는 검정 실루엣.
deck.en: A short gray jacket above a long black silhouette.
deck.de: Eine kurze graue Jacke über einer langen schwarzen Silhouette.

intro.ko: 빵집 앞에서 봉투를 여미는 작은 동작이 단정한 착장에 표정을 만듭니다.
intro.en: A small movement outside the bakery gives this clean outfit its expression.
intro.de: Eine kleine Bewegung vor der Bäckerei gibt dem klaren Outfit seinen Ausdruck.

body.ko: 스톤 톤 쇼트 트렌치 아래 검정 크루넥과 스트레이트 팬츠를 이어 입었습니다. 재킷의 짧은 길이와 팬츠의 긴 선이 만나 전신 비율이 또렷합니다. 리본 발레 플랫과 작은 숄더백은 같은 검정으로 정리하고, 귀 옆 후프만 은은하게 빛나게 했습니다. 밤 산책에 가볍게 겹쳐 입는 방식입니다.
body.en: The stone short trench sits over a black crewneck and straight trousers. Its cropped length contrasts with the long trouser line, making the full silhouette easy to read. Bow ballet flats and a small shoulder bag repeat the black, while little hoops add a quiet glint beside the face. Light layers keep the look relaxed for a night walk.
body.de: Der kurze steingraue Trench liegt über schwarzem Rundhalspullover und gerader Hose. Seine kurze Länge steht im Kontrast zur langen Hosenlinie und macht die ganze Silhouette lesbar. Ballerinas mit Schleife und eine kleine Schultertasche greifen das Schwarz auf; kleine Creolen setzen einen ruhigen Glanz neben dem Gesicht. Leichte Lagen passen zum entspannten Abendspaziergang.
